name: NFL wind under (Rule B)
rule: Bet the under when the forecast wind at an outdoor stadium is 15 mph or more, 1 to 3 days before kickoff, at Pinnacle's price of −115 or better with positive expected value.
decided_text: After Week 18 of 2026 if 40 signals settle in the 2026 regular season; otherwise once, after the 2027 regular season, on both seasons pooled. Kept only if average CLV is above zero with a 95% interval above zero; since amendment 7 (Sep 29), that interval is the wider of the plain interval and one grouped by game day.
note: A signal at the backup price (the consensus line) is logged and reported separately; it is not part of the decision.

name: NFL model lean
rule: Log the model's lean when it gives the under a 55% chance or more (or 45% or less, for the over), at the earliest run at least 24 hours before kickoff that has a posted total. Watch only: log, don't bet.
decided_text: Like Rule B: after Week 18 of 2026 if 40 signals settle in the 2026 regular season; otherwise once, after the 2027 regular season, on both seasons pooled.

name: College football wind under (Rule B)
rule: Bet the under when the forecast wind at an outdoor FBS venue is 15 mph or more, 1 to 3 days before kickoff, at −115 or better with positive expected value.
decided_text: After 40 signals or the end of the regular season (Dec 12, 2026), whichever is later. Kept only if average CLV is above zero with a 95% interval above zero; since amendment 5 (Sep 29), that interval is the wider of the plain interval and one grouped by game day.

name: College football high-total under (Rule HT)
rule: Bet the under when the posted total is at least 62.6 (last season's average closing total plus 10), at −115 or better, at the last quote before kickoff.
starts_text: Week 6, with games kicking off from Tue Oct 6, 2026, 8:00 PM ET
decided_text: Once, after the 2027 season's title game, on 2026 Week 6 onward and 2027 pooled. Promoted only if the win rate beats the break-even of the prices taken (one-sided p < 0.05) and ROI is above zero. About 105 bets are expected.
note: Graded at the last quote before kickoff, so an early signal can still fall away. Stays on paper through 2027.
